cases.description: A 12 MiB container in 5 MiB parts (5, 5 and 2 MiB). Each part is accepted in order; complete checks the length and the SHA-256 of the whole and stages it (201); completing again is 200 with the original result; beginning again with the same parameters is 200 and says it is staged, and with another digest or size it is ObjectConflict (409).
cases.name: a_container_is_staged_in_parts

cases.description: The 7.1 maximum is accepted with 8 MiB parts (129 parts); one byte more is SnapshotTooLarge (413) whatever the digest.
cases.name: a_snapshot_at_the_maximum_is_accepted_and_one_byte_over_is_too_large

cases.description: A part size below 5 MiB is MalformedRequest (400); above the operator's snapshot_part_max_bytes it is PayloadTooLarge (413); both are judged after the size and before any state is looked at.
cases.name: the_part_size_is_bounded

cases.description: A size of zero, a non-decimal size, an upper-case or short digest, a part_size that is not a decimal, a missing member and an unknown member are each MalformedRequest (400).
cases.name: the_request_body_is_strict

cases.description: The same parameters while the upload is in progress answer 200 with its state (next_part moves with it); a different digest, size or part size under the same snapshot id is ObjectConflict (409).
cases.name: beginning_again_is_a_retry_and_a_different_begin_is_a_conflict

cases.description: Every part but the last must be exactly part_size, and the last exactly the remainder: one byte short, one byte over, and a last part that is not the remainder are MalformedObject (400); a part longer than the operator's snapshot_part_max_bytes is PayloadTooLarge (413). A refused part leaves next_part where it was.
cases.name: a_part_of_the_wrong_size_is_refused

cases.description: Part numbers are decimals from 1 to 10000 (0, 10001 and a non-decimal are MalformedRequest, 400); a part past the next one expected, or past the last, is PartOutOfSequence (409) carrying next_part; a part for a snapshot never begun is UploadNotFound (404).
cases.name: a_part_number_must_be_the_next_one

cases.description: A part already received with the same length and bytes answers 200 with the original next_part; the same length with other bytes is ObjectConflict (409).
cases.name: a_part_sent_again_is_idempotent_and_a_different_one_is_a_conflict

cases.description: Complete with parts missing is UploadIncomplete (409) naming the first missing part, and keeps the upload so the client can send it.
cases.name: complete_before_every_part_has_arrived_is_incomplete

cases.description: The client declared a digest that is not that of the bytes it sent. Complete is MalformedObject (400) and the server discards the upload: the next part and the next complete are UploadNotFound (404), a begin starts afresh (201, not staged), and the snapshot was never staged.
cases.name: a_digest_that_does_not_match_stages_nothing_and_discards_the_upload

cases.description: A container smaller than 5 MiB is a single, last part; the 5 MiB minimum applies to every part but the last. It stages.
cases.name: a_container_below_the_part_minimum_is_one_small_last_part

cases.description: Abort removes an upload in progress (200, aborted true) and is idempotent (200, aborted false); a part after it is UploadNotFound. Abort never removes a staged snapshot: after a completed upload it answers aborted false and the snapshot is still staged.
cases.name: an_upload_can_be_aborted

cases.description: The first failing step answers. A malformed body is judged before writes; a size over the maximum before the writes check; an exact retry of an upload in progress is 200 even when writes are suspended; a new upload when writes are suspended is WritesSuspended (403), and when the quota is exhausted QuotaExceeded (403) only after the conflict and writes checks.
cases.name: the_decision_order_of_begin

cases.description: For a part: the upload is looked for before the sequence, the sequence before writes, and writes before the size. For complete: a retry after success is 200 even when writes are suspended; a new complete when writes are suspended is WritesSuspended (403) before UploadIncomplete.
cases.name: the_decision_order_of_part_and_complete

cases.description: After A reports a halt, A's begin, part and complete are ReplicaHalted (409) with the reported position, so a halted device cannot stage a snapshot by the other path; A's abort still works (it only cleans up); B and an account credential are not affected.
cases.name: a_device_with_a_recorded_halt_cannot_stage_in_parts

cases.description: stageSnapshot refuses a container over the operator's snapshot_single_request_max_bytes with PayloadTooLarge (413) carrying the limit; one at the limit stages. The same bytes staged through the parts path give the same staged snapshot, so beginning with their size and digest is 200 and says staged.
cases.name: a_snapshot_over_the_single_request_limit_is_staged_in_parts_and_the_result_is_the_same

decision_order_of_begin: 1 authenticate (not exercised: every credential here is valid)
4 size: SnapshotTooLarge; part_size above the operator's maximum PayloadTooLarge, below 5 MiB MalformedRequest
5 exact retry: 200 with the state; another snapshot or upload under the id: ObjectConflict
decision_order_of_complete: 2 the upload exists, or this is a retry after success (200): UploadNotFound
5 the whole container's length and SHA-256: MalformedObject, and the upload is discarded
decision_order_of_part: 4 sequence: a received part 200 or ObjectConflict; a part past the next PartOutOfSequence
how_to_read: Each case is a list of steps against ONE server that starts empty: nothing staged, no halts, writes permitted, quota available. The operator limits are fixed for the file: snapshot_part_max_bytes and snapshot_single_request_max_bytes are 8388608, snapshot_upload_expiry_seconds is 604800, and the server's clock is 2026-11-03T12:00:00Z, so a new upload expires at 2026-11-10T12:00:00Z. A step may change the conditions for that step only ('conditions': writes_permitted false, quota_exceeded true). 'credential' is 'A' or 'B' (devices) or 'account' (an account credential before the genesis). 'begin', 'part', 'complete' and 'abort' are beginSnapshotUpload, putSnapshotPart, completeSnapshotUpload and abortSnapshotUpload; 'stageSnapshot' is the single-request operation, which stands in for a container by its length and fill byte; 'reportHalt' records a halt for the credential's device. 'bytes' is {length, fill}: the part or container is 'length' copies of the byte 'fill'. 'expect' is the outcome: a 'status' and the response members named, or 'error' for a non-2xx response, or 'details'. The clear-header check of part 1 is the container check stageSnapshot shares and is not in this file.
synthetic: Every value is synthetic. Parts and containers are described by a length and a repeated byte; the SHA-256 a client declares is that of those bytes. No key, signature or sealed object is in this file.
